name: Rampardos

attacks.name: Head Smash
attacks.text: If your opponent’s Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

flavor:
In ancient times, people would dig up fossils of
this Pokémon and use its skull, which is harder
than steel, to make helmets.
